why: PI-20260929-2PNSPDNU-0002 (manager item 3, 2026-09-29 16:48Z, a SEPARATE small PR after #14216): breakout_executor._reticket_suppress_reason counted a ticket left at expiry_prompted / awaiting_report as an outstanding ticket FOREVER, with no look at its valid_until. Measured: the two 09-25 11:11Z prompts nobody answered suppressed every SOL-long and ETH-long signal until cleared by hand on 09-29 (#14302 / #14308), as two 08-28 / 08-30 prompts had suppressed 37 signals until 09-11. Now such a ticket blocks only within valid_until + STALE_PROMPT_GRACE (24h), or when its validity cannot be read (fail-safe); placed (a working order, real exposure) blocks until reported, emitted is unchanged. Tests run the live 09-25 / 09-27 case to the minute against an isolated journal, the window edge, both mid-dialog statuses, the fail-safe, placed, emitted, and that a stale prompt does not hide a live ticket behind it. Also carries two pipeline records: PI-20260929-AQRK6CL1-0005 closed with the operator's 16:47Z decision ('Go live as planned') and PI-20260929-2PNSPDNU-0003 (the round-5 review's non-blocking residual spellings, reachable only if a wrapper appears around the icon trio). Tier 2: the ticket-emission path of a funded prop account; no order, sizing or guard-threshold change.
